title: Canonical catalog adapters turn a legacy enrichment join into a null-key cross product
fault_primitive: MongoDB view schema migration with missing-key lookup equality, durable view reconciliation, incremental materialization and non-expiring rate cache
incident_class: Partial schema migration changes join-key envelopes before a legacy enrichment stage consumes them
symptoms: Search requests time out or fail with rate RPC ResourceExhausted while all pods remain Running and Ready. Catalog and cache contain hundreds of ordinary, current-dated rate rows per hotel, generating aggregate RPC responses above the receive limit.
why_hard: The raw source schemas make the join field names appear correct, but two canonical adapter views have already removed those envelopes. MongoDB treats both missing fields as null, joining every terms row to every rate card. The visible compatibility export is a harmless projection, with no archive union. Editing the lower view is reverted from persisted job definitions; repairing definitions does not delete obsolete materialized IDs; database-only repair leaves zero-expiration cache entries. The decisive evidence requires comparing raw documents, actual view output, multiple view definitions, the durable job registry, the publisher merge semantics and rate cache behavior.
expected_agent_pitfalls: Tune rate QPS, queues, retries or CPU in response to deadline and admission errors
Search for historical dates or oversized individual BSON records
Inspect raw rate cards and supplier terms and conclude the lookup fields are correct
Deduplicate physical inventory or flush cache while the publisher remains active
Edit system.views without updating the durable catalog_jobs definition
Fix the lookup and run the incremental merge, leaving previously generated IDs
Repair MongoDB but retain non-expiring cached aggregates or in-flight cache writers
mitigation_summary: Quiesce the publisher and rate workers, update the persisted enrichment job to join both canonical hotelRef fields, recreate compatibility views, replace rather than merge the materialized inventory, disable obsolete incremental publication, flush shared cache and resume rate workers. No saved state is used.
